mlxVideo.hint: Reinstall mlx-video from the Blaizzy/mlx-video git source. Use this on Apple Silicon when LTX-2 generation fails with ``ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mlx_video.ltx_2'`` (the unrelated PyPI 0.1.0 package shadowed the real one), or when a prior install left the package partially staged.
mlxVideo.installed: mlx-video installed. Restart the backend to activate.
mlxVideo.failed: Install failed — see the pip output below.
mlxVideo.confirm: Reinstall mlx-video from the Blaizzy/mlx-video git source? This pulls the package fresh from GitHub (replaces any stale or PyPI-shadow install) and takes 1-2 minutes. Use this on Apple Silicon to enable LTX-2 native generation, or after a failed install left the package partially staged.

cuda.hint: Reinstall CUDA torch into the extras directory. Use this on Windows/Linux when an NVIDIA GPU is detected but torch imports as CPU-only, or when a prior install left stale / mismatched torch files in extras. The main-page banner offers the same action but can be dismissed — this button is always available.
cuda.installedFrom: Installed from {index}. Restart the backend to activate.
cuda.noWheel: No CUDA torch wheel exists for Python {version}. Ship ChaosEngineAI against a supported Python (3.13 recommended).
cuda.failed: Install failed — see the log tail below for the full pip output.
cuda.confirm: Reinstall CUDA torch into the extras directory? This downloads ~2 GB, takes 1-5 minutes, and replaces any stale or CPU-only torch currently installed. Use this when the GPU is detected but torch imports stuck as CPU.

reextract.hint: Advanced: delete the cached embedded runtime and re-extract on next restart. Use this only when the runtime tree looks corrupted (rare — usually after a crashed install).
reextract.confirm: Delete the cached embedded runtime extraction? The backend will re-extract from scratch on the next restart. Use this when the runtime tree looks corrupted (rare — usually after a crashed install).
reextract.deleted: Runtime cache deleted at {path}. Click Restart Backend to re-extract.
reextract.nothing: No cached runtime to delete at {path} — next restart will extract fresh.
